headline: Last session: Sensex rose 300 points as markets recovered from a sharp midweek sell-off; Nifty near 23,150.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 28 September.

why: Recovery in auto and consumer durable sectors boosted indices on Friday
Sharp midweek crash driven by crude oil prices surging above $100
Proposed insurance curbs and oil spike led to the worst day in 10 weeks on Thursday
Global buying in AI stocks like Microsoft provided a positive lead for investors
whatHappening: Nifty recorded its longest weekly losing streak since the 2020 Covid-19 crash
The RBI Bulletin highlighted economic resilience despite downside risks from West Asia
Government reduced FY27 borrowing by ₹1.2 trillion, targeting ₹7.8 trillion in H2
Virtual pharma firm HRV is preparing for an IPO with a DRHP expected in 2027
summary: On the last trading day, the Sensex gained over 300 points, recovering slightly from a massive 1,248-point midweek crash. Despite the recovery, the Nifty logged its longest weekly losing streak since 2020 due to high oil prices and geopolitical tensions. Meanwhile, the RBI remains optimistic about economic resilience while the government cut its borrowing targets.
